observed_gap.trigger: A nested node was edited or moved while an unlocked intermediate container sat below a locked ancestor.
observed_gap.before: Lock checks stopped at the selected node and its immediate parent, allowing deeper descendants to bypass the ancestor lock.
observed_gap.impact: Canvas and hierarchy commands could mutate content inside a locked subtree or move it across the lock boundary.

implementation.behavior: The command layer rejects mutations below any locked ancestor. Palette insertion resolves outside the whole locked subtree. Canvas drag/resize, text surfaces, Inspector controls, layer drag and visibility actions follow inherited lock state.
implementation.atomicity: Rejected command cases preserve the Page Model and Undo history.
implementation.name_sync: Inspector node rename is reflected by the Layers tree after Save and Publish.

open_source_review.reference: GrapesJS collection-based component hierarchy and locking patterns reviewed in the earlier 77.44.7.A insertion slice.
open_source_review.decision: No third-party code or dependency is needed; ancestor authorization must be enforced by this project’s canonical Page Model commands and UI.
